channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Bam Adebayo | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Bam Adebayo from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Jimmy Butler on his former teammate Bam Adebayo scoring 83 points:

“Good for him. 83 is a lot of points, and he is a crazy, talented player. He can do everything incredibly well. But it’s always a team effort. Nobody just gets scored 83 on. It’s a team thing, you know, you’re sending double teams. (And a ref thing?) Could be. Double teams, triple teams, whatever. The whole, whatever you call it, shebang, the whole team, the whole book, whatever. And he made shots, a lot of them. So good for him. 83 is historic.”

Jimmy Butler on Bam Adebayo, Oct 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Eric Nehm:Giannis Antetokounmpo, on how Bam Adebayo can bring the best out of him:

“He doesn't take days off... I know he didn't take any days off against me.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Bam Adebayo, Sep 28, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Max Strus on Donovan Mitchell, Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Max Strus on Bam Adebayo:

“Me and Bam are tight. Bam’s awesome. That’s the last person I would want to mess with. Donovan Mitchell is a specimen but Bam Adebayo, holy sh*t. He’s a big dude.”

Max Strus on Donovan Mitchell, Bam Adebayo, Aug 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Bam Adebayo, Tyler Herro
item.description:
Carmelo Anthony on Tyler Herro and Bam Adebayo altercation:

“We was just in a bunker for eight years... We done went to war for eight seasons... The minute that you leave, you put that out there... So that told me that was brewing and what we were building wasn't real… so if you went out there to told somebody you don't even know this information, that told me that I got to approach you the way that I feel like is the best way because if you don't stop it right away, it keeps going.”

Carmelo Anthony on Bam Adebayo, Tyler Herro, Jul 27, 2026. Source: Youtube.

item.title: Pat Riley on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Riley, on Adebayo's importance to theHeat:

“I forgot to mention one of these guys...and I don't want to get knocked out.”

Pat Riley on Bam Adebayo, Jul 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on LaMelo Ball, Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra on LaMelo Ball's trip of Bam Adebayo:

“He should be penalized for that. I don't think that belongs in the game, tripping guys.”

Erik Spoelstra on LaMelo Ball, Bam Adebayo, Apr 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Bibby on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Bibby acknowledged that Kobe Bryant’s 81-point game is probably more impressive given the circumstances.

“Bam (Adebayo)’s a Jordan guy, so it’s a great privilege, great honor that he got that,”

Mike Bibby on Bam Adebayo, Mar 17, 2026. Source: R.Org Sports.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
(6) Spoelstra on the Adebayo 83:

“I would do it ten times out of ten again for Bam. I'm apologizing to nobody about this. I feel just so awesome, you know, for Bam because he is about, you know, all the right things.”

Erik Spoelstra on Bam Adebayo, Mar 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
(5) Spoelstra on the Adebayo 83:

“I'm not losing any sleep over what other people are saying about it. What's ethical? What's not? Like, you know, is fouling a three-point shooter, is that ethical or not? Is fouling a bad free throw shooter and getting extra possessions, you know, or not? Like, all this stuff happened under two minutes, like I said. Like, he had already broken a bunch of records and we're going to go for it.”

Erik Spoelstra on Bam Adebayo, Mar 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
(3) Spoelstra on the Adebayo 83 (and on playing a tanking team):

“It was probably irony in these two organizations. There's nothing wrong with what they're doing. If you can, tank and get a great draft pick, I don't care. You can do anything you want in this league. You can approach it however you want. We don't do that.”

Erik Spoelstra on Bam Adebayo, Mar 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
HoopsHype: Spoelstra on Adebayo:

“Max players, if they’re not scoring and they’re starting to get criticism... usually there will be friction (...) Instead of there being any friction, I had my annual 5K run for Nicklaus Children's Hospital, and he showed up without even letting me know.”

Erik Spoelstra on Bam Adebayo, Mar 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
(2) Spoelstra on the Adebayo 83:

“The fact that he was still in the game at the end, you know, this is what our fans want to see. And this is what you really want to see happen in this league is for there to be some competitive storylines. And then a brilliant, magical night just appeared out of nowhere. And, you know, seize that opportunity.”

Erik Spoelstra on Bam Adebayo, Mar 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: David Adelman on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
David Adelman on Bam Adebayo's 83 points:

“That guy is as professional as it gets in our league and what he stands for in the NBA. So for him to take one night and kind of go a little bit crazy, I don’t think it’s a bad thing.”

David Adelman on Bam Adebayo, Mar 11, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kelly Oubre Jr. on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Kelly Oubre Jr. on Bam Adebayo’s 83-point game:

“I’m just going to say this: Joel did it efficiently and he did it in three quarters.”

Kelly Oubre Jr. on Bam Adebayo, Mar 11, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Erik Spoelstra on Bam Adebayo missing time with his back issue:

“He really needed this time. ... I think he's feeling a lot better each day.”

Erik Spoelstra on Bam Adebayo, Dec 27, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Norman Powell, Bam Adebayo, Tyler Herro
item.description:
“Y’all know how good Norman is. He was an All-Star this year out there in the West. So for the Heat to be able to get a player like that with Bam [Adebayo], with Tyler [Herro] as the No. 1 and No. 2 options, all right. Let’s go.”

Dwyane Wade on Norman Powell, Bam Adebayo, Tyler Herro, Jul 16, 2025. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Caron Butler on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
“When you talk about versatility, when you talk about two-way defender, I mean it's a crime that [Bam Adebayo] hasn't won Defensive Player of the Year,”

Caron Butler on Bam Adebayo, Sep 11, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Tyler Herro on Jimmy Butler, Terry Rozier, Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Herro told me in an exclusive interview.

“It may look a little different, but we have young guys that we hope will continue to get better. Bam Adebayo and I are young guys who are starting to become full-fledged veterans in this league. Terry Rozier is healthy now and ready to compete. Then you have Jimmy Butler, who is extra motivated after not being able to play in the playoffs last season.”

Tyler Herro on Jimmy Butler, Terry Rozier, Bam Adebayo, Aug 20, 2024. Source: Forbes.com.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Kevin Durant, Bam Adebayo
item.description:
“It’s going to be different every night. Tonight was my night. The first night was KD [Kevin Durant]. The second was Bam [Adebayo]. So, I mean, it’s not about getting mine. It’s just the ball was finding me. It was swing, swing. I was doing, you know, a recipient for all those swings, swings, and I was able to knock it down.”

Anthony Edwards on Kevin Durant, Bam Adebayo, Aug 3, 2024. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
“I always try to add to the team. I was able to do that. Bam (Adebayo) passed up an open shot to get me a shot, which got me going.”

Kevin Durant on Bam Adebayo, Jul 28, 2024. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Nikola Jokic on facing Bam Adebayo:

“I think he's really effective in everything that he does. He can guard 1 through 5. He's the glue guy and the guy that is leading them. It's always a pleasure to battle against him.”

Nikola Jokic on Bam Adebayo, Mar 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: Terry Rozier on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Terry Rozier on playing with Bam Adebayo:

“The pick and roll is gonna be special. You have to pick your poison.”

Terry Rozier on Bam Adebayo, Jan 24, 2024. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Duncan Robinson on Bam Adebayo, Tyler Herro
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Duncan Robinson on his role with Bam Adebayo and Tyler Herro returning:

“The mindset shifts a little bit maybe just with the role change. But in the grand scheme of things, just try to keep everything the same. When I'm out there, play the same way. Be assertive, aggressive and play with confidence.”

Duncan Robinson on Bam Adebayo, Tyler Herro, Dec 18, 2023. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Erik Spoelstra on Bam Adebayo:

“When you have your leader play like that, it inspires everybody else. That’s the best way to put it. He makes everybody believe with his efforts, his two-way ability, anchoring our defense against an explosive offensive team.”

Erik Spoelstra on Bam Adebayo, Nov 12, 2023. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Nikola Jovic on Kevin Love, Jimmy Butler, Bam Adebayo, Max Strus, Gabe Vincent, Duncan Robinson
item.description:
Nikola Jovic:

“For sure, for sure. I’m sure I’m more ready. More ready mentally and physically. The shot also is going to help me a lot. We have some great players that dominate the paint like Jimmy Butler and Bam Adebayo. If you get a wide open three, they want you to make it. That’s why you have guys like Max Strus and Gabe Vincent, Duncan Robinson, K-Love (Kevin Love) who always are going to make shots and they needed to be great to be where we were last year. It’s something we need and it’s something I’m trying to just think about all the time and be ready and confident. Because when I get it, I know they want me to make it.”

Nikola Jovic on Kevin Love, Jimmy Butler, Bam Adebayo, Max Strus, Gabe Vincent, Duncan Robinson, Sep 25, 2023. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Lillard said on the podcast.

“Bam [Adebayo] is my dawg. Bam is my dawg for real. Miami is the obvious one.”

Damian Lillard on Bam Adebayo, Aug 5, 2023. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Jaime Jaquez Jr on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Brady Hawk:Jaime Jaquez Jr on Bam Adebayo:

“I love Bam man, he plays so hard.. I’m so excited to play on the floor with him. I think we’re gonna play really well together.”

Jaime Jaquez Jr on Bam Adebayo, Jun 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Jimmy Butler, Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Erik Spoelstra:

“That partnership between Jimmy Butler and Bam Adebayo is special, it's unique.”

Erik Spoelstra on Jimmy Butler, Bam Adebayo, Jun 14, 2023. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Erik Spoelstra:

“I just think overall the first quarter disposition was more important than the schematics or strategy; but we were active. And I thought Bam Adebayo was a major part of that. He was all over the place, both ends of the court.”

Erik Spoelstra on Bam Adebayo, May 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Pat Riley on Dwyane Wade, Alonzo Mourning, Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Riley told the Miami Herlad.

“I go back to [Alonzo Mourning] and Zo was a franchise face and then Dwyane [Wade] along with Udonis [Haslem], andnow I look at Bam Adebayo the same way because of longevity. I see Bam here, I hope, for his whole career.”

Pat Riley on Dwyane Wade, Alonzo Mourning, Bam Adebayo, Feb 17, 2023. Source: Heat Nation.
